from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from drf_spectacular.generators import SchemaGenerator
from .models import FinancialInstitution

class BankingInstitutionSchemaView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        inst_code = request.query_params.get('institution_code')
        institution = FinancialInstitution.objects.get(routing_code=inst_code)

        # Verify that the user is an authorized technical contact for this specific institution
        if not institution.authorized_users.filter(id=request.user.id).exists():
            raise PermissionDenied('Not authorized to access settlement schema for this institution')

        generator = SchemaGenerator(
            urlconf=f"banking_rails.{institution.internal_package_name}.urls",
            title=f"Settlement API - {institution.name}"
        )
        schema = generator.get_schema(request=request, public=False)
        return Response(schema)
